"name": "onSearchRequest",
        "min_manifest_version": 3,
        "type": "function",
        "description": "Registering this listener will create a read-only address book, similar to an LDAP address book. When selecting this address book, users will first see no contacts, but they can search for contacts, which will fire this event. Contacts returned by the listener callback will be displayed as contact cards in the address book. Several listeners can be registered, to create multiple address books.",

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted provider code treats MV3 results as vCard strings. In MV2, an explicit vCard property takes precedence over flat properties. It sets directoryUID on each card, reports the supplied isCompleteResult after successful delivery and translates caught conversion/dispatch failures to onSearchFinished. Preserve those versioned representations and completion signals. The wakeup await is outside that try block, so this does not prove that wake-up failures finish the search. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep MV3 provider result values distinct from MV2 flat cards
